_readme: GPU catalog. memory_gb/bandwidth/TFLOPS drive sizing and the theoretical throughput estimate. cloud[] holds per-GPU-hour rates by provider. Measured throughput lives in benchmarks.json. reserved_terms_per_gpu_hr (optional) holds commitment rates by term in years ("1", "3", "5"); the calculator uses the longest term that does not exceed the chosen comparison term.
